title: Hearty Polish Mushroom Tagine
description: A tangy and flavorful Polish dish featuring mushrooms, cacao, and a blend of spices, cooked in a tagine and perfect for a solo dinner, dairy-free friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the cacao powder, tagine spice blend, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the mushrooms are tender and the sauce has thickened, about 20 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
